claim: At the fixed CROMA optical-SAR interface, classifier-tangent selective projection may preserve useful residual complementarity while capping classifier-visible displacement.
hypothesis: A parameter-free detached classifier-geometry projection of the final multimodal residual improves dense segmentation under the matched SEN12TS protocol.
experiment: Direct full-horizon seed-0 CTSP-01 validation on the frozen SEN12TS train/validation split for 24 epochs under CE+Lovasz.
falsification_criterion: Best validation mIoU gain below +1.0pp closes CTSP; +1.0 to <+2.0pp is marginal and does not unlock controls.

effect_evidence.basis: Best validation epoch 16 versus frozen baseline best epoch 18.

prior_art_assessment.nearest_prior_art: SING classifier range/null invariants; CLEAR cross-modal covariance projection; DOLG orthogonal feature fusion; TokenFusion; CROMA and optical-SAR fusion.
prior_art_assessment.new_axis: Bounded classifier-visible displacement of an already formed optical-SAR residual while preserving its tangent complement at the fixed EO VFM interface.
prior_art_assessment.novelty_claim_boundary: Only the narrow CTSP residual operation is tested; all geometry, fusion, CROMA and dataset components are not claimed new.
prior_art_assessment.what_is_not_new: Pseudoinverse, null/tangent projection, residual clipping, multimodal fusion, CROMA and SEN12TS.
